title: MGDA-DECOUPLED: Geometry-Aware Multi-Objective Optimisation for DPO-based LLM Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance across multiple conflicting alignment objectives (Helpfulness, Instruction Following, Honesty, and Truthfulness) using an LLM-as-a-judge to ensure equitable trade-offs and prevent the systematic under-weighting of harder-to-optimize or minority-preferred objectives.
